title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 code execution was possible via symlinks in an imported settings archive…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 allows code execution via symbolic links in an imported settings archive. This flaw could enable an attacker with local access to execute arbitrary code by crafting a malicious settings archive containing symlinks. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-123841 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
